_note: Single source of truth for BuyWise seed data. Ported from Shoppy's src/lib/matching/dictionary.ts (225 entries) + supabase/migrations/002_seed_categories.sql. Generated fixtures/canonical_items.json and migrations/002_seed.sql are produced by `cargo run -p buywise-cli -- generate-fixtures`. Edit this file, then regenerate; do not hand-edit outputs. Alias variants are verbatim here (NOT normalised); the generator applies the BuyWise normaliser (punctuation -> space) and dual-inserts each variant under both 'en' and 'es' as INPUT-LOCALE MATCHING BUCKETS (not linguistic assertions). Future matching MUST treat item_aliases.language as a ranking hint, not a hard filter, and GROUP BY canonical_item_id so dual-inserted aliases don't double-count.
